title: Search for files within a specific folder
summary: Limit your file search to a specific directory using mdfind. This is helpful when you know which folder contains the file but want to search its contents or names within that scope.

aliases.text: как найти файлы в папке на маке

steps.explain: Use the -onlyin flag to restrict the search to a specific directory path, followed by your search query.

placeholders.name: DIRECTORY
placeholders.description: The path to the folder you want to search within.

placeholders.name: QUERY
placeholders.description: The text or phrase to search for.
